title: Tiny, cute motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#243b5e'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='72' r='13' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='72' r='9' fill='#57d9ff'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='72' r='4' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='72' r='13' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='72' r='9' fill='#57d9ff'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='72' r='4' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <!-- frame / body -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q50 52 68 60 L72 66 L64 68 Q50 60 36 68 Z' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <!-- body panel -->
  <path d='M40 52 Q56 46 66 54 Q60 62 48 60 Q42 58 40 52 Z' fill='#ff8fa8'/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M42 50 Q54 44 64 50 Q56 48 46 50 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- fuel tank highlight -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q54 48 62 53' stroke='#ffd0dc' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <path d='M66 50 L72 42 L78 44' stroke='#c8d4ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='45' r='5' fill='#fff28a'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <path d='M32 68 L42 70' stroke='#c8d4ff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little heart above -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q46 14 50 12 Q54 14 50 20 Z' fill='#ff5a7a' transform='translate(0,-2)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ff8fa8'/>
</svg>
